title: Ball-proximal point method on a Hadamard Manifolds
summary: We consider the problem of minimizing a proper, lower semicontinuous, geodesically convex function on a Hadamard manifold. Building on ball-proximal (broximal) ideas in the Euclidean setting, viewed as an abstract proximal-type algorithm, we propose and analyze a Riemannian ball-proximal point method (RB-PPM) whose basic step consists of minimizing the objective function over a metric ball centred at the current iterate.
